label: Afro-Soul
description: soulful vocals over warm, organic instruments and interlocking African-influenced rhythms.

client_references.explanation: Broad soulful, African-influenced facet of a genre-blending sound; not an exclusive artist definition and not a voice to copy.

production_traits.musical_identity: afro-soul: soulful melodic vocals over a warm organic ensemble with interlocking African-influenced hand-percussion rhythms and a gentle sway
instrumentation: acoustic and clean electric guitar figures
warm electric keys or a small acoustic piano
interlocking hand percussion, conga, shaker and rim patterns
light kit joining only after the story opens
avoided_instrumentation: synthesized pan-flute or generic world-music decoration
production_traits.rhythm: warm 4/4 pulse with syncopated interlocking subdivisions; parts answer each other rather than all playing the same accent

tempo.note: gentle sway; no acceleration to fit words and no default club tempo

production_traits.vocal_delivery: soulful, melodic and clear lead with controlled call and response or one voice of harmony only when the approved material calls for it, dry upfront vocal

energy_map.consequence: spoken consequence stays close over a light organic guitar figure
energy_map.obstacle: complementary percussion parts enter as pressure grows
energy_map.choice: percussion reduces for an intimate realization
energy_map.change: warmer interlock and vocal lift restore after the consequential choice
energy_map.hook: refrain gains emotional warmth from the action already in the scene plan
energy_map.cta: final refrain settles into the warm interlock under the CTA

production_traits.hook_guidance: one soulful refrain whose warmth is earned by the action in the scene plan; no unrelated celebration and no repetitive chanting
production_traits.spoken_sung_split: spoken lines carry the consequence; verses and the refrain are sung; call and response only when approved, no rap by default
production_traits.delivery_constraints: preserve the client's language and accent; no fabricated dialect, ethnic identity, chant, instrument tradition or cultural claim follows from choosing the style
production_traits.word_fit: place stresses against the interlock with space for vowels and consonants; keep the lead clear over percussion instead of fitting extra words through speed
production_traits.story_energy: reflective or gently energetic as the story requires; neither automatically slow and sad nor automatically club dance-pop

duration_guidance.60: spoken consequence, one groove section, one refrain and the CTA; the interlock stays exposed
duration_guidance.90: two sections with percussion entering on the obstacle, refrain returns warmer
duration_guidance.120: three beats, one percussion reduction at the choice, warmer interlock after
duration_guidance.180: add a second guitar figure and one instrumental interlock passage that advances the story
duration_guidance.300: four consequential beats, a stripped middle section, a re-harmonized final refrain
duration_guidance.600: long-form with developed scenes and evolving percussion conversations; no repetitive chanting and no filler

examples: A returned apron lies by the door; the lead speaks the cost over guitar, and a warm percussion weave grows when they choose to return.

section_hint: [Verse] spoken consequence, [Groove] interlocking percussion, [Hook] soulful lift, [Outro] warm interlock
negative_constraints: no invented dialect, chant or cultural claim
no artist name or alias in any production field
